segments.caption: A business news anchor presents a segment on electric vehicles, with a graphic overlay stating “Electric cars making earth more green,” while a background image shows a white electric car plugged into a charging station.

A news anchor introduces a segment on electric vehicles, with a graphic overlay showing a car being charged. The scene then cuts to a live demonstration at an auto show, where a man and a woman examine the open hood of a light-colored Kia electric car, followed by a close-up of a hand plugging in a charging cable to power the vehicle.

At an exhibition, a light green Kia EV is being plugged into a charging station, demonstrating the vehicle's charging process. A representative from the Korea Environment Corporation, Yoo Dong-kun, is interviewed, confirming that a charging system was established last year to support up to 500 electric vehicles and that plans are underway to build another charging station.

A representative from the Korea Environment Corporation, Yoo, Dong-kun, speaks to the camera at a trade show or exhibition, outlining the expansion of Korea's electric vehicle charging infrastructure. He details plans to build a new system this year with a capacity for 2,600 vehicles, aiming to encourage more EV adoption and improve air quality. At the 2012 EV Korea exhibition, a business fair dedicated to the electric vehicle industry, attendees and exhibitors gather to showcase innovations. A representative from the exhibition team speaks about the event’s purpose, while displays feature advanced electric vehicles, including a white and blue OLEV bus and a green KATECH bus, highlighting the industry's focus on sustainable transportation.
